system.description: You can cause the force of age to afflict a portion of your target's body. Spend a Willpower Trait and touch the part of the body you wish withered (this may require a Physical Challenge first). The target receives two aggravated wound levels, and whatever was touched is crippled and useless until both levels have healed; for mortals, this crippling is permanent. Each use can affect any single limb or sensory organ (two uses to fully blind or deafen someone). Targets are two Traits down in any challenges calling for the affected limb or sense. This power cannot be used to wither vital organs.
